nom: COSRX AHA/BHA Treatment Toner for Whiteheads & Clogged Pores

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some who are also acne-prone, report it controls sebum, unclogs pores, and reduces breakouts without over-drying their skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-sensitive skin, including one with dry, flaky skin and one with dehydrated winter skin, generally report it balances and smooths their skin, though one found it a bit drying and cut back frequency.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one combining oily and dry patches with sensitivity, report it smoothed their skin and reduced breakouts after an initial purging period.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin are split: several say it's the rare product that never irritates their easily-reactive skin, but one with sensitive skin returned it unused fearing it would be too harsh, and another broke out in red, welt-like bumps.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reported the toner smoothed a wrinkled, aging-looking patch on her cheek alongside general texture improvements, though this was a single, incidental observation rather than the product's main focus.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the mist as light, hydrating, and non-drying even with regular use; a couple, however, including one with dry/sensitive skin, found it a bit drying compared to other toners and cut back to a few times a week instead of daily.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and pigmentation over weeks of use, including one whose face normally 'blows up in red blotchy spots' with other products; one reviewer, however, broke out in red, itchy, welt-like bumps on her face and chest within minutes of spraying it, which she suspected was an allergic reaction.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers, including some using it for hyperpigmentation, freckles, or old acne scars, report their dark spots and marks faded and their skin looked brighter after regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several with acne-prone or cystic acne-prone skin, report significantly fewer breakouts and faded acne scars over weeks of consistent use, though a common theme is an initial 'purging' phase with more whiteheads or pustules in the first one to two weeks; a couple of reviewers, however, describe more lasting breakouts or a welt-like reaction rather than a purge.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner controls sebum, reduces small bumps and visible pores, and doesn't clog pores, with one calling it just as effective as a higher-alcohol toner she'd used before, but gentler.

aspects.libelle: Bottle arrives opened, unsealed, or looking used
Fine mist makes application quick and easy
Works better applied with a cotton pad than misted directly

extraits.titre: I have really sensitive skin so not sure
extraits.texte: I've been using this clarifying treatment toner for about a week now, and I'm giving it 3 stars because I'm still on the fence about its effectiveness. Initially, I was excited to try this product as it promised to balance my skin's pH and reduce acne. However, after using it consistently for 2 weeks, I've started to experience a breakout - which is the opposite of what I was hoping for. That being said, I do think this toner has helped to reduce the appearance of pores and has left my skin feeling clean and refreshed. The breakout could be due to a purging phase, but I'm not entirely sure. I'll continue to use this product and see how my skin adjusts, but for now, I can only give it an average rating. If you're considering trying this toner, I'd recommend starting with a small patch test to see how your skin reacts.

It made me breakout in red itchy welts on my face & chest. I know it caused the reaction because it was just after me spraying the bottle. It was at night, the second time I used it I sprayed it on my chest and face and after 3 minutes I got a noticeable, red, welt like pimple, it was almost like an allergic reaction. It not only formed on my cheek, but I also found some on my chest too; it feels like a bump.. I'm glad I can get a free refund. My skin type is normal-dehydrated/dry in the winter. I just wanted a good toner that was beneficial to my skin, this was not it; that is why because I'm worried I will get more itchy bumps from this product I will be returning it.

extraits.titre: It works but can be a little drying
extraits.texte: Ok sooo chat gpt recommended this toner for me based on my skin profile and It’s fair to say that it did a pretty decent job. Compared to my other toners it’s not as gentle and can be a little drying but its easy to keep up with compared to another toner from this brand that I find just to harsh for my skin type. I notice actual results in the following days proceeding and I found a sweet spot of about 3 x per week rather than daily. This paired with some snail mucinex and a ceramide is definitely my power combo for my sensitive/ dry skin.

extraits.titre: I finally found my holy grail product for acne
extraits.texte: It's been a very long journey of me searching for the perfect product that doesn't make me break out and is not too oily for my oily skin. I did have my reservations before ordering this but I figured it is worth a try. I have occasional acne, a few pimples here and there, along with old acne scars that never faded. I've tried vitamin C serums and salicylic acid before to no avail. Here is my nightly routine before bed: 1. Hada Labo Hyaluronic Foam Cleanser 2. COSRX AHA/BHA Toner 3. Hada Labo Gokujun Hyaluronic Lotion 4. COSRX Snail Mucin 96% Power Repairing Essence 5. Nature Republic Aloe Gel (as an extra moisturizer when I feel like it) 6. SoonJung Panthensoside Cica Balm (only for spot treatments or those colder nights) The first few days it is not noticeable that it's doing anything different. However after a few weeks, I noticed I've been getting a lot less breakouts. And my acne scars have started to fade. After two months, my complexion has evened out even more (the scars are still there, but it's just less red and blends in more with the rest of my face). Then I decided to stop using the AHA/BHA toner spray for a week because I was running low, and I immediately started getting a few pimples. I guess that's my sign that I must start stocking this product regularly! I have read reviews on AHA/BHA products in general and it's advised to use this product at night because it will make your skin more sensitive. If you use it in the day, you MUST use sunscreen afterwards. I

extraits.titre: Love it! Worked wonderfully for me.
extraits.texte: I rarely write Amazon reviews but I just had to come here to say how much I love this product! I have combination oily and dry very sensitive skin. I break out easily to new products (had a recent horrible breakout to biore sunscreen too). It's been about 14 days since I started using this and oh my lord, it has helped my skin smoothen out so much and decreased breakouts. I started using it because I learned BHA can help with sebaceous filaments which I had grown an unusually large amount on my face these past few months. It did made me purge in the first week (had giant whiteheads and pustules) but my skin is calmer now and smoother. I pair this with Cerave facial cleanser and Avene skin recovery cream and it's a miracle combo! The only thing I don't like is the spray top. It doesn't work very well misting it on face or applying by hand. You have to follow the instructions to wet a cotton pad and smoothe over skin for it to be fully effective in my opinion and that's worked better for me. I'll definitely keep buying this for sure.

I have dry sensitive skin! I have no idea why I thought that this product would be compatible with my skin type! Don't get me wrong, I absolutely LOVE LOVE LOVE COSRX!!! But I came to the conclusion that this product would be too harsh for my sensitive skin! Never opened! Never used! I can't attest to it's effectiveness! But what did give me the glowey, dewy and glass like skin in the picture above was the COSRX Propolis line! Tried and true and definitely recommend! That's what I'm giving a 5⭐️ review for!

My redness and pigmentation has significantly gone down. I did a lot of research on this product and heard great reviews from friends and professionals. In the beginning of of using it, my skin did purge because I think this product extracts the bad bacteria from the skin, but after a few weeks of using it, my skin is soft and smooth. My skin type is dry and acne prone.
